fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects changes to environment variables related to ETW logging via the CommandLine.
This could indicate potential adversaries stopping ETW providers recording loaded .NET assemblies.
fields.name: ETW Logging Tamper In .NET Processes Via CommandLine
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "COMPlus_ETWEnabled" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "COMPlus_ETWFlags"))
